EX-99.1 2 irenreportsq1-fy27result.htm EX-99.1 irenreportsq1-fy27result 1 IREN Reports Q1 FY27 Results Quarterly AI Cloud Revenue Nearly Triples to $200 Million Summary: • Total quarterly revenue increased 66% sequentially to $228 million • AI Cloud quarterly revenue increased 182% sequentially to $200 million1 • AI Cloud segment gross margin of 86%, in line with prior quarter2 • Revenue backlog increased 22% sequentially to $20.3 billion; approximately two-thirds with investment-grade counterparties3 • More than $4 billion ARR4 target is fully contracted and fully funded5 • Expanded contract with Leading Frontier AI Lab post-quarter end NEW YORK, November 5, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) today reported financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and provided an update on its AI Cloud business and growth plans. “This quarter Horizon 1 went into service for Microsoft with NVIDIA Exemplar status, AI Cloud revenue nearly tripled to $200 million, and operating ARR doubled to a billion,” said Daniel Roberts, Co-Founder and Co-CEO of IREN. “The more than $4 billion of contracted ARR is funded and now targeted for January, after a customer-requested design change and supplier timing moved it from year-end; it may extend to the end of February. Since quarter-end we have signed a five-year contract at about $22 million per megawatt with 90% of the GPU capex prepaid by the customer, and a short-term contract at $40 million per megawatt. We own the land, the power and the data centers under all of it, which gives us more ways to fund growth and lets us set its pace.” Q1 FY27 Financial Results US$ Million Quarter ended Quarter ended conditions, to drive future capacity targets12 Q1 FY27 Results Webcast & Conference Call IREN will host an audio webcast of the conference call to discuss the results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time. A live audio webcast of the conference call can be accessed at IREN’s Investor Relations website: iren.com/investors. A replay of the webcast will be accessible shortly after the call at https://iren.com/investor/events-and- presentations About IREN IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud platform, delivering data centers, compute and software for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of land and grid-connected power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC. Contacts Investors ir@iren.com Media media@iren.com 3 Assumptions and Notes 1. Total AI Cloud Revenue comprises AI Cloud Services Revenue of $135m and AI Cloud Lease Revenue of $65m (prior quarter: $71m and nil, respectively), per our unaudited condensed consolidated statements of operations. 2. Adjusted EBITDA and Total segment gross profit are non-GAAP financial measures. AI Cloud segment gross margin is AI Cloud segment gross profit (Total AI Cloud revenue less AI Cloud cost of revenue, excluding depreciation and amortization and before site-level costs) divided by Total AI Cloud revenue. Refer to the reconciliations at the end of this press release to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures. 3. Revenue backlog includes remaining performance obligations plus remaining lease arrangements plus other amounts we estimate may be recognized as revenue in future periods under committed customer contracts, in each case, subject to the satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements. Investment-grade share is based on the credit ratings of counterparties or their guarantors as of September 30, 2026.
